facts.fact: CRAN declined Starlink's application for a Class Comprehensive Telecommunications Service Licence and a Spectrum Licence for fixed satellite services; the decision date was 23 March 2026.

CRAN rejected the reconsideration requests (622 of 624 declined as procedurally invalid, 2 reviewed on merit) and upheld its March decision to decline Starlink's licence application; Starlink's own late request of 8 June 2026 was also dismissed (briefing the week of the 24 June 2026 article).
